entities.name: PMID:27496265
observations: 2016 retrospective chart review of 21 girls with chronic functional pain disorders; compared 11 with benign joint hypermobility to 10 non-hypermobile controls.

No significant group differences in POTS, syncope, orthostatic intolerance/hypotension, tilt heart-rate measures, sudomotor index, or assessed pain-associated comorbidities; authors concluded BJH was not the driver of autonomic abnormalities.

entities.name: BJH minimally impacts autonomic findings
observations: In 21 girls with chronic functional pain disorders, benign joint hypermobility was not associated with significant differences in autonomic diagnoses or measured autonomic indices versus non-hypermobile controls; small retrospective sample limits certainty.
